# RSNA Knee Compact v1 (restored)

The dataset has been restored. I removed it earlier because someone told me it wasn't allowed, but it seems to be allowed after all. All versions are public again.

This latest version holds the same model files as Version 10, byte for byte (bundle `209a32c8b50a6b1c`): four ConvNeXt-small fold models (`E_lrprior_s0_f0.pt` to `E_lrprior_s0_f3.pt`), the side classifier `side_cls.pt`, `manifest.json` and `state_spec.json`. Notebooks that attach the latest version get the same files as Version 10.

The 0.954 notebook: <https://www.kaggle.com/code/heliosli/dataset-restored-i-d-been-told-it-wasn-t-allowed>

Feel free to blend my model with yours!
